Full scoring withheld pending the Amanda/Cameron walkthrough-scheduler mini-rubric decision (Week 2).
top_strength: Roselyn efficiently walked through detailed intake across both properties (square footage, bedrooms, extra spaces like the shed, walk distance, access concerns, box count) and smoothly pivoted to texting the virtual walkthrough link the moment phone-based probing hit its limit.
coaching_note: Roselyn never set an agenda for the call or used the customer's name (Charlie/Charles) a single time in over 7 minutes; opening with something like "Hi Charlie, this is your kickoff call to confirm the details before your July 30th move, should take about 10 minutes" would have removed the customer's own confusion about why he was being called and built rapport she never got to.
phone_presence_notes: Polite and apologetic during the hold ("thank you so much for patiently waiting, I do apologize for the long wait") but entirely transactional otherwise — no name use, no humor, minimal affirmations beyond "no problem."
